recipe.visualDefinition: A centered monochrome portrait of a man in formal attire and a fedora, framed by a torn-paper collage effect revealing a cloudy blue sky on the left, with bold, wide-set typography and a vertical orange accent bar.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome subject against a textured off-white background
Torn paper edge separating the portrait from a blue sky element
Heavy, wide-set display type contrasting with a vertical accent bar
Symmetrical facial positioning anchored by a horizontal hat brim
coreInvariants: Burnt orange vertical rectangle on the right margin
Torn paper texture with visible deckle edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium-close-up portrait, head and shoulders filling the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's eyes and the horizontal line of the fedora brim.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top text, moves down to the eyes, then follows the vertical orange bar on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Off-white textured space surrounding the head, balanced by the sky element on the left.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burnt Orange (Vertical bar) and Sky Blue (Left collage element)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast in the portrait; muted, earthy saturation in the accent colors.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to one primary accent hue besides the blue sky

letterConstructionRules: Drop shadows on primary display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are flattened to emphasize width over height

composition.relationshipToImage: Layered on top with a subtle drop shadow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying scales of the same extended sans-serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical, and bold 90s aesthetic.
Provides the necessary geometric squareness and width.
Offers a similar wide-set, clean-lined feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A monochrome studio portrait of a man wearing a fedora and a white shirt with a tie, holding a jacket over his shoulder. The background is off-white paper texture. On the left side, add a torn paper effect that reveals a bright blue sky with white clouds underneath. On the far right, add a solid vertical burnt orange rectangle with a torn paper edge on its left side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add wide-set, horizontally stretched sans-serif text in uppercase at the top center with a subtle drop shadow. Add a vertical stack of uppercase letters inside the orange bar on the right, using wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait monochrome or sepia?
Does the text have a horizontal stretch?
Is the torn paper effect visible on the left?
Is the orange bar present on the right?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the torn paper edge
Saturation of the orange accent bar
Amount of horizontal stretch in the typography
Density of the clouds in the sky element
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the eyes
Check that the torn edge looks organic, not digital
Verify the orange bar is perfectly vertical
Confirm the sky element is only visible through the 'tear'
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered monochrome portrait with a 'torn' collage reveal of a secondary environment (sky/nature) and anchor the composition with extremely wide-set, bold sans-serif display type.
